answer:
The newest release notes in my context are v0.32.8, not 0.32.15. I don't have notes for 0.32.9 through 0.32.15, so I can't say whether they change anything.

According to v0.32.8, Ollama can run Muse Glimmer on all platforms:

"Muse Glimmer is now available on all platforms." [ollama/v0.32.8.md]

The same release lists the platform work it added:

"Add Muse Glimmer support for NVIDIA, AMD, and additional platforms" [ollama/v0.32.8.md]

The earlier v0.32.7 release had support only on Apple Silicon, through Ollama's MLX engine:

"Muse Glimmer is currently available via initial support via Ollama's MLX engine on Apple Silicon." [ollama/v0.32.7.md]

So as of v0.32.8, the support covers Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, AMD, and other platforms. The notes don't give a more detailed list of "additional platforms."
